subject: US-270: Memory Relevance Ranking API Endpoint
description:
# US-270: Memory Relevance Ranking API Endpoint

## Objective
Implement the  API endpoint as specified in SPEC-031.

## Technical Tasks
- Create GET /memory/relevant endpoint
- Add query parameters: context, limit, context_id
- Integrate with relevance engine
- Return memories with relevance scores
- Handle errors gracefully

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Endpoint implemented
- [ ] Response time <5ms
- [ ] Proper error handling
- [ ] Unit tests

## Estimated Effort
8-12 hours (1-1.5 days)

subject: US-271: Memory API Relevance Score Integration
description:
# US-271: Memory API Relevance Score Integration

## Objective
Integrate relevance score updates into existing memory API operations.

## Technical Tasks
- Update /memory/remember to update scores
- Update /memory/recall to track access
- Add relevance scores to responses
- Async score updates

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both endpoints updated
- [ ] Scores included in responses
- [ ] No performance degradation
- [ ] Graceful error handling

## Estimated Effort
12-16 hours (1.5-2 days)

subject: US-272: Enhanced Context Matching for Relevance Ranking
description:
# US-272: Enhanced Context Matching

## Objective
Enhance context matching algorithm for better relevance scoring.

## Technical Tasks
- Implement TF-IDF scoring
- Add phrase matching
- Add stemming/lemmatization
- Optional semantic similarity
- Hybrid scoring approach

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Enhanced matching implemented
- [ ] Performance <10ms
- [ ] Backward compatible
- [ ] Unit tests

## Estimated Effort
16-24 hours (2-3 days)

subject: US-273: Performance Testing and Validation for Relevance Ranking
description:
# US-273: Performance Testing

## Objective
Create performance tests to validate SLO requirements.

## Technical Tasks
- Test 10K keys latency <5ms
- Test top-N retrieval
- Test concurrent access
- Validate memory usage <10MB per 10K users
- Load testing

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All SPEC requirements validated
- [ ] Benchmark results documented
- [ ] SLO compliance confirmed

## Estimated Effort
12-16 hours (1.5-2 days)

subject: US-274: Relevance Statistics API Endpoint
description:
# US-274: Relevance Statistics API

## Objective
Add observability endpoint for relevance engine statistics.

## Technical Tasks
- Create GET /memory/relevance/stats endpoint
- Return comprehensive statistics
- Admin access control

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Endpoint implemented
- [ ] Admin access working
- [ ] Unit tests

## Estimated Effort
4-6 hours (0.5-1 day)
